about:
Suminoe Textile of America (STA) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Suminoe Textile Ltd., a Japanese company with roots in Osaka dating back over 125 years. STA began operations in April 2003 at a purpose-built manufacturing facility in Gaffney, South Carolina, placing it in the heart of the Carolina textile corridor where it draws on the area's deep pool of textile expertise.

The company produces automobile interior furnishings at full scale for the North American market, focusing on seat fabrics, floor mats, and carpets. Its finishing capabilities include printing, etching, napping, and sueding, applied to automotive textile substrates to meet OEM specifications.

STA serves the automotive industry, supplying interior textile components to vehicle manufacturers and tier-one suppliers across North America. Its product lineup centers on automotive fabrics and carpet systems for passenger vehicles, with all production occurring at its Gaffney plant.

The company cites its ISO/TS16949 certification from TÜV as evidence of its quality commitment, and emphasizes its strategic location in a region with deep textile manufacturing heritage as a competitive advantage.
